info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Procurement Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033/034). Drafts a purchase order (a reference, a vendor, a requester, one currency, an expected day and numbered lines with a category from a fixed list, an item identifier, a quantity and a price; the total is kept in minor units), reads and lists it with the filters (status, vendor, currency, fulfilment, late), updates the draft (the lines are replaced, the reference and currency stay), reads the receipts and the audit log in order, cancels it, and shows what an order that is not placed refuses (receipts, placing, decisions). Sending an order for approval and everything after it needs the real approval service and a provisioned policy, so it is proved by the platform smoke (procurement-smoke), not here. A second folder proves the service is staff only (403 ERR-PRC-00403 for a REQUESTER on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (unknown category or currency, an item or a delivery reference that is a sentence, a missing item, quantities of zero or over 100000, negative or three-decimal prices, an absurdly large total, a bad reference, a day in the past, over two years ahead or unreadable, a missing or malformed vendor, missing executor, an unknown outcome, line number or filter), duplicates (409), illegal transitions, tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (poOrganisationId).
